source_text: Isaac fodit iterum puteos patris quos Philisthim obturaverant. Aqua viva — Verbum quod inimici terra obstruunt.
pass_a_gloss: Isaac dug again wells of-father which Philistines had-blocked. Water living — Word which enemies with-earth obstruct.
pass_b_english: [[Isaac digs again his father’s wells that the Philistines had stopped >> Bible:Genesis 26:15-18]]. Living water — the Word enemies choke with earth.
